manifest.name: NestJS
manifest.runtime: Node.js 26.13.1 LTS, NODE_ENV=production, compiled with nest build (tsc)
manifest.database_layer: TypeORM 1.1 via @nestjs/typeorm with pg, 8 connections per process (16 in total)
manifest.logging: none per request (Nest has no request logger); start-up log per process

phase2.validation: ParseIntPipe for the id; ValidationPipe with class-validator DTOs for the query, the JSON body and the form: 400

session.mechanism: express-session 1.19 with connect-pg-simple 10 (the documented session middleware with its PostgreSQL store), on /form, /login and /me only

manifest.notes: Nest's documentation recommends the NodeAdapter since v12.3; Nest still uses Express when no adapter is passed.
